description: This file defines an interface for a logical search filter that combines other search filters using boolean operators AND, OR, and negation. It provides methods to retrieve constituent filters and a string representation of the logical filter.

classes.name: LogicalSearchFilter
classes.description: An interface representing a logical combination of search filters, supporting AND/OR concatenation and negation.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of search filters concatenated by this logical filter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the logical search filter, illustrating the logical combination using a prefix and comma-separated component filters.
